items.title: Jeff Weltman Discusses Why Magic Signed Kevin Porter Jr.
items.summary: The Magic signed free agent guard Kevin Porter Jr. on Wednesday amid a 7-10 start to the season. President of basketball operations Jeff Weltman discussed the team’s thinking behind the move on Wednesday night in a phone interview with Jason Beede of The Orlando Sentinel. “We’re trying to get better. We’re looking at our team and seeing where we need help,” Weltman said. “You’re never going to find the perfect player to address every need, especially when you’re looking to acquire a player who (was) presently unsigned.
